before_claim_section.heading: Statement
before_claim_section.text:
Let $R$ be Noetherian and $M$ finite and globally Cohen--Macaulay. Then
$M[X]$ is globally Cohen--Macaulay over $R[X]$.

after_claim_section.heading: Statement
after_claim_section.text:
Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $R$ be Noetherian and $M$ finite and globally Cohen--Macaulay. Then
$M[X]$ is globally Cohen--Macaulay over $R[X]$.

before_claim_section.heading: Statement
before_claim_section.text: Let $G\leq\operatorname{GL}(V)$ be a finite complex reflection group, $n=\dim V$, $S=\mathbb C[V]$, and $R=S^G$. Let $f_1,\ldots,f_m$ be minimal homogeneous invariant generators of $I=SR_+$, with $d_i=\deg f_i>0$. Their common zero set is $\{0\}$, $m=n$, and they form an $S$-regular sequence. Every homogeneous lift of a homogeneous complex basis of $S/I$ is a graded free $R$-basis of $S$.

after_claim_section.text: Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $G\leq\operatorname{GL}(V)$ be a finite complex reflection group, $n=\dim V$, $S=\mathbb C[V]$, and $R=S^G$. Let $f_1,\ldots,f_m$ be minimal homogeneous invariant generators of $I=SR_+$, with $d_i=\deg f_i>0$. Their common zero set is $\{0\}$, $m=n$, and they form an $S$-regular sequence. Every homogeneous lift of a homogeneous complex basis of $S/I$ is a graded free $R$-basis of $S$.

before_claim_section.heading: Statement
before_claim_section.text:
Let $W\leq\operatorname{GL}(V)$ be a finite complex reflection group, in particular a finite Weyl reflection group, with $r=\dim V$. Put $S=\mathbb C[V]$, $R=S^W$, $I=SR_+$, and let $d_1,\ldots,d_r$ be the degrees of basic invariants. Then
$$\operatorname{Hilb}(S/I,t)=\prod_{i=1}^r(1+t+\cdots+t^{d_i-1}),\qquad \dim_{\mathbb C}(S/I)=\prod_i d_i=|W|.$$

after_claim_section.heading: Statement
after_claim_section.text:
Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $W\leq\operatorname{GL}(V)$ be a finite complex reflection group, in particular a finite Weyl reflection group, with $r=\dim V$. Put $S=\mathbb C[V]$, $R=S^W$, $I=SR_+$, and let $d_1,\ldots,d_r$ be the degrees of basic invariants. Then
$$\operatorname{Hilb}(S/I,t)=\prod_{i=1}^r(1+t+\cdots+t^{d_i-1}),\qquad \dim_{\mathbb C}(S/I)=\prod_i d_i=|W|.$$

before_claim_section.heading: Statement
before_claim_section.text: Let $W$ be a finite Weyl group acting faithfully on its $r$-dimensional complex reflection representation $V$, and put $S=\mathbb C[V]$. Then $S^W$ is a polynomial algebra on $r$ homogeneous algebraically independent basic invariants, and $S$ is free of rank $|W|$ over $S^W$. More generally these conclusions hold for every finite subgroup of $\operatorname{GL}(V)$ generated by complex reflections (nonidentity transformations fixing a hyperplane pointwise). In the Weyl case the generating root reflections have order two; no classification or Coxeter presentation is needed here.

before_claim_section.text:

$k[X_1,\ldots,X_n]$ is a

current_statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $\mathfrak g$ be a finite-dimensional complex semisimple Lie algebra with Cartan subalgebra $\mathfrak h$, a chosen positive-root system and corresponding Borel, Weyl group $W$, and half-sum $\rho$ of positive roots. Let $\chi_\lambda$ and $\chi_\mu$ be the central characters obtained from highest weights $\lambda,\mu\in\mathfrak h^*$ for this Borel. Then

$$\chi_\lambda=\chi_\mu \quad \text{if and only if} \quad \mu\in W\cdot \lambda,$$

where $W\cdot \lambda:=\{w(\lambda+\rho)-\rho : w\in W\}$.
